filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 5 Arabic videos. The English selection features highly-rated, comprehensive tutorials from well-known channels like Dani Krossing and Traversy Media. The Arabic selection is dominated by the top-tier channel Elzero Web School, providing authoritative content on most topics. For some niche security topics in both languages, videos explaining the 'why' (the attacks) were chosen to provide essential context where direct implementation tutorials were lacking or weak.
